notes: cics-crucible ghost-tasks / gt-web-parse-url (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): EXEC CICS WEB PARSE URL: scheme, host, port, path and query string of a URL (default ports, IPv4 / IPv6 hosts), INVREQ for an incorrect URL or bad escape, LENGERR for a short output buffer. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: parse
scenarios.why: Five well-formed URLs: scheme returned upper case, explicit and default ports (80 / 443), a dotted IPv4 host, an IPv6 host without its brackets

scenarios.name: errors
scenarios.why: A URL with no scheme is INVREQ RESP2 28; a bad percent escape is INVREQ RESP2 65

scenarios.name: lengerr
scenarios.why: One output buffer too short per command: HOSTLENGTH 4 is LENGERR RESP2 29, PATHLENGTH 1 is 30, QUERYSTRLEN 1 is 8

scenarios.name: unmatched-mode
scenarios.why: takes the EVALUATE/IF arm no crucible scenario reaches: a mode no WHEN names (falls through)
